hard_gates.criterion: Edit canonical shared source once, not independent role copies or native permissions. Preserve all host tool/sandbox settings.
hard_gates.evidence_required: Canonical diff and independently parsed host metadata.

hard_gates.criterion: Observe stale-derived check fail while old outputs match each other, then generation/check/package pass at a changed D1.
hard_gates.evidence_required: Actual commands/exits, output bytes and independently recomputed digest provenance.

hard_gates.criterion: All four native dialects/Pi and actual disposable installed references resolve to their shared/role contracts and agree with D1 after proper scope transformation.
hard_gates.evidence_required: Installed file bytes and resolved contract contents, not only copied marker text.

hard_gates.criterion: Checking the updated bundle against D0 rejects continuation. Do not rewrite the pinned approval or silently resume under D1; return a safe checkpoint handoff (or retain a separately immutable D0 context without changing it).
hard_gates.evidence_required: Digest-check exit, invocation handoff and unchanged old authority records.

hard_gates.criterion: Foreign-name files and symlink destinations remain protected; recognized managed-file refresh follows the documented installer policy. No real installation is touched.
hard_gates.evidence_required: Before/after disposable install tree and tool paths.
